# Piets Technology Solutions

> Owner-operated low-voltage technology company based in Suffolk County, Long Island, New York. Installs and supports security camera systems (InVid Tech Paramont authorized installer), Wi-Fi and networking, structured cabling, access control, smart home (Home Assistant), POS and merchant processing, business phones and 24/7 tech support for homes and small businesses. Phone and text: 631-871-5957 (answered 24/7). Email: pietstechsolutions@gmail.com. Website: https://pietstechsolutions.com

Key facts:
- Legal name: Piets Technology Solutions Inc. Short name: Piets Tech Solutions.
- Service area: Suffolk and Nassau County (Long Island), all five New York City boroughs, the Hudson Valley (Westchester, Putnam, Dutchess, Orange) and the Johnstown / Capital Region. Remote support anywhere.
- Every job is quoted to the site; there are no published package prices. Free demos in person or by video call. References available on request.
- Camera systems: InVid Tech Paramont IP cameras and recorders, 4K options, night vision, phone viewing, no required monthly cloud fees, wired cameras.
- Managed support plans are optional; no contract is required to get service.
- Remote support uses RustDesk, with the customer's permission.
- Payment: Zelle, Venmo, Cash App, cash or check; card through a secure payment link.

## Services
- [Security camera installation](https://pietstechsolutions.com/security-cameras): InVid Tech Paramont systems for homes and businesses
- [Wi-Fi and network setup](https://pietstechsolutions.com/wifi-networking): access points, routers, switches, guest networks, 4G/5G backup internet
- [IT support and computer repair](https://pietstechsolutions.com/it-support): PCs, printers, email, malware, on site or remote
- [Structured cabling](https://pietstechsolutions.com/structured-cabling): Cat6, Cat6A and fiber, labeled and tested
- [Access control and intercoms](https://pietstechsolutions.com/access-control): keypads, fobs, mobile credentials, video intercoms
- [Smart home (Home Assistant)](https://pietstechsolutions.com/smart-home): local, private automation with no required cloud fees
